guard: a family follower's stored copies (#5404): fan-out routes the family rows above a channel, the reader accepts a copy that any covering row holds, covering rows store one copy because the dedupe id is per message and lifecycle, each channel's own delivery class decides, the reader re-checks the read ACL per concrete channel; the daemon admits a family join only inside one read-ACL entry; family catch-up copies durable-class channels under their own names; catch-up eviction is judged per sender subject on the daemon; and the agent joins, leaves and boots a family whatever the space default
why: The suite imports CotalEndpoint from ../src/index.js, but @cotal-ai/smoke-kit resolves @cotal-ai/core through dist/, so the command builds core first and afterRestore rebuilds it, leaving no dist/ compiled from a mutant.
Every 'stores nothing' cell is closed by a later post on a channel that does store, so a mutation that stops delivery entirely reddens the marker half rather than passing the negative half.
